name: Encouragement
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, hope, mind-affecting]; Level bard 2, mesmerist 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.
Targets allies within a 30-ft. burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You complete the spell and give a call of encouragement to your allies. All allies may immediately make a save against one ongoing mind-affecting effect of the ally’s choosing (with the exception of curses). If the effect is a despair effect, the subject gains a +4 morale bonus on this save. This spell cannot be used on characters under a charm effect or under dominate person or similar spell.
